findings.quote: Helium is shown as the special case placed with the noble gases.
findings.problem: Lesson tableau-valence (7th) uses the noble-gas family before lesson familles-gaz-nobles (8th), whose goal is to introduce it. Its prerequisites (configuration, element-isotopes) and the collège list do not introduce it. Its misconception « L’hélium (1s²) se place dans la même colonne que le béryllium. » can only be corrected with that family argument.
findings.evidence: Style guide line 9: « Order of notions: never use a notion before it is introduced, in this lesson or in a prerequisite lesson of the plan. » Referential p. 6: « Associer la notion de famille chimique à l’existence de propriétés communes et identifier la famille des gaz nobles. » anchored by the plan to lessons[7]; p. 4 collège notions list no noble gases.
findings.fix: Helium is shown as the special case: its tile sits at the top of the last column, above neon, and not next to beryllium; the step states this placement as given and announces that lesson familles-gaz-nobles explains it.
